id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_010.pack|cs_: "La la la, what a lovely sea breeze! ...Once we're through here, it's the open sea. Stay sharp.
"I heard a noise from the hold. Could you go check, {var:1}?
"Munch, chomp...! Gulp...!
"{var:1}, are you all right? I brought the others too... Wait!
"...E-Erik!?
"Oh, Erik! You're alive after all! I knew you'd not go down easily.
"As expected of Erik! ...But it's truly good. Right, {var:1}?
"...F-Forgive me!
"I haven't eaten for three days... I saw food being loaded on this ship and, in a moment of weakness...
"...U-Um, Erik?
"Waah!?
"What's going on? Isn't this man Erik?
"Um... My name is probably Erik, yes...
"But how do you know it... Do you know something about me?
"Could it be... you've lost your memory?
"...I can't remember the past. When I came to, the world was in ruins, and I don't understand anything.
"All I remember is my name and... that there was something important I had to do... That's about it.
"I've no right to ask, but... if you know me, could I travel with you?
"Especially with you, I feel I might remember something... I'll pay for the food I stole. I'll clean, wash dishes, anything!
"Hm. Traveling with us may bring back your memory.
"And leaving Erik as he is now would be dangerous. {var:1}, let's take him, shall we?
"Hm, but {var:1}, you know Erik is essential to the battles ahead, don't you?
"Thank you! I'll try not to be in the way.
Erik rejoined the party!
"...Hm, it feels itchy. If Veronica saw you now, she'd roll about laughing."
